children.title: Mechanisms and Thermodynamic Constraints of Autocatalytic Memory

detail.title: Mechanisms and Thermodynamic Constraints of Autocatalytic Memory
detail.summary: Stoichiometric submatrix conditions characterize irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks capable of maintaining persistent history-dependent states under thermodynamic non-equilibrium.
detail.reason: Revised notebook incorporating stoichiometric submatrix criteria and thermodynamic persistence models.

children.title: Heredity Thresholds and Stoichiometric Conditions in Prebiotic Chemical Systems

detail.title: Heredity Thresholds and Stoichiometric Conditions in Prebiotic Chemical Systems
detail.summary: Integration of thermodynamic erasure costs into the heredity threshold framework demonstrates that the transition from simple chemical mixtures to evolutionary systems is constrained by both information-theoretic erasure limits and the requirement for objective pointer states.
detail.reason: Revision required to incorporate thermodynamic constraints on information retention and the criteria for objective state persistence.
